title: Large Language Models: A Mathematical Formulation
abstract: arXiv:2601.22170v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) process and predict sequences containing text to answer questions, and address tasks including document summarization, providing recommendations, writing software and solving quantitative problems. We provide a mathematical framework for LLMs by describing the encoding of text sequences into sequences of tokens, defining the architecture for next-token prediction models, explaining how these models are learned from data, and demonstrating how they are deployed to address a variety of tasks. The mathematical sophistication required to understand this material is not high, and relies on straightforward ideas from information theory, probability and optimization. Nonetheless, the combination of ideas resting on these different components from the mathematical sciences yields a complex algorithmic structure; and this algorithmic structure has demonstrated remarkable empirical successes. translated_title: 大型语言模型：一种数学表述
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）处理并预测包含文本的序列以回答问题，并处理包括文档摘要、提供推荐、编写软件和解决定量问题等任务。我们通过描述文本序列到令牌序列的编码方式、定义下一令牌预测模型的架构、解释这些模型如何从数据中学习，以及展示它们如何被部署以应对各种任务，为LLMs提供了一个数学框架。理解这些材料所需的数学水平并不高，依赖于信息论、概率和优化中的基本概念。尽管如此，将这些来自数学科学不同组成部分的思想相结合，产生了一种复杂的算法结构；而这种算法结构已展现出显著的实证成功。
tldr: 本文为大型语言模型提供了一套统一的数学框架，涵盖文本编码、模型架构、学习过程及任务部署，并强调其基于基础数学概念但实现复杂算法结构。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a unified mathematical framework for large language models, covering text encoding, model architecture, learning processes, and task deployment, highlighting that it builds on basic mathematical concepts yet yields complex algorithmic structures.
